# Semestero ME (סמסטרו ME)

> An advanced, local-first academic skill tree and degree navigation platform engineered for Technion Mechanical Engineering and Barak students.

Semestero ME transforms undergraduate degree management into an interactive, visual skill tree and Notion-style workspace. Designed specifically for the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology (הפקולטה להנדסת מכונות), it empowers students to plan semesters, balance workloads, simulate GPAs, and synchronize assignments directly from Technion Moodle and CheeseFork.

## Core Capabilities

- **Interactive Academic Skill Tree**: Visualizes prerequisite chains, co-requisites, core vs. elective branches, and semester allocations across the entire degree curriculum.
- **Degree Planner & Workload Engine (מתכנן תואר)**: Multi-semester curriculum planner featuring real-time credit tracking, semester workload metrics, Reservist credit exemptions (פטור מילואים 2 נק״ז), and drag-and-drop course reallocations.
- **Academic GPA & What-If Simulator**: Exact Technion-weighted GPA calculation, pass/fail (בינארי) handling, credit quotas, and what-if simulation for target GPAs and honors requirements.
- **Notion-Style Task & Exam Command Center**: KanBan boards, table views, Eisenhower priority matrix, exam date countdowns, and XP gamification.
- **Technion Moodle Live Sync**: Secure, passive iCal feed synchronization (`export_execute.php`) importing real homework and assignment deadlines without storing credentials or passwords.
- **CheeseFork Academic Database Integration**: Auto-completion and instant catalog lookup for course numbers, names, credits, faculties, and official prerequisite graphs.
- **Local-First Privacy Architecture**: Zero server tracking or telemetry; 100% of user notes, grades, tokens, and progress remain strictly on the client device (LocalStorage / Electron storage).

## Curricula & Catalogs Supported

- **Technion Faculty of Mechanical Engineering (הנדסת מכונות)**:
  - Catalog 2023–2024 (תשפ״ד - 157.5 credits)
  - Catalog 2024–2025 (תשפ״ה - 157.5 credits)
  - Catalog 2025–2026 (תשפ״ו - 157.5 credits)
  - Catalog 2026–2027 (תשפ״ז - 157.5 credits)
- **Barak Elite Program (מסלול ברקים)**:
  - Combined B.Sc. + M.Sc. curriculum (171.5 credits)

## Architecture & Technology

- **Frontend**: Lightweight, high-performance vanilla ES6+ JavaScript, modular architecture, responsive CSS3 with CSS variables and glassmorphism UI.
- **Offline & Desktop**: PWA with offline Service Worker caching (`sw.js`) and cross-platform native Electron desktop packaging.
- **Data Persistence**: Offline-first JSON storage, automated schema migrations, zero third-party cloud database dependencies.
